gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-stix-two-text: STIX Two Text is a serif whose thin strokes stay only slightly lighter than its thick ones. Balsamiq Sans, the display heading, draws every line at full width with no hairline thinning, so the two meet in a pleasingly mismatched way.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-tai-heritage-pro: Balsamiq Sans draws each stroke at full width, so its joins never thin into hairlines and the letters look cut from one channel. Tai Heritage Pro, a dignified serif, has crossbars a touch thinner than its stems.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-taviraj: Balsamiq Sans lays down a flat, sign-painter's-stencil line with no tight pinches, and Taviraj sits beneath it in a classic serif manner. Its soft shifts in thickness never turn stark, so paragraphs flow gently.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-trirong: Every stroke in Balsamiq Sans is cut to a single width, giving the headings a smooth, tube-like look. Trirong, a bookish serif, brings modest weight change in its round letters, which is the quality that makes the pair work.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-trocchi: Trocchi reads dignified and classic, with a wide-open ring for its c and bowls that thin gently rather than sharply. And Balsamiq Sans holds one track width like a neon sign tube, so the text serif below feels softer by comparison.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-trykker: Trykker is a classic serif with understated thick-thin contrast and open counters that breathe into the white space. And Balsamiq Sans above it keeps every curve unpinched, so a long passage settles into a literary, refined rhythm.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-uchen: Dignified and refined, Uchen is a text serif whose lowercase curves welcome the eye in, with a soft shift like a lightly pressed brush. Balsamiq Sans is best at bold, one-pen-tip headings; Uchen at quiet detail.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-vollkorn-sc: Vollkorn SC is a literary serif with medium contrast, terminals cut short of the bowl and loosely spaced tracking. But Balsamiq Sans is the one with the drawn-wire weight, bold and expressive, while Vollkorn SC offers the tempered flex of spring wire.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-yuji-syuku: Yuji Syuku reads authoritative and open, spacing every glyph pair generously, with curved strokes that end before turning inward. Yuji Syuku, a classic serif, can take a slightly larger size than the heading font, since its hairlines stay sturdy.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-ibm-plex-serif: Smooth as a tube, bold and loose. Balsamiq Sans leads, and IBM Plex Serif follows with low-key thick-thin variation, so a long passage feels corporate and authoritative without stiffness.
